conflicts.description: The meeting notes and recording say the board would be open to investing EUR 60,000–80,000 in AI-related projects if the first pilot shows results. The company overview says the 2027 budget proposal earmarks EUR 50,000 for digitalisation and AI pilots. The report instructions give no source priority, so the different budget figures remain unresolved.
